title: The Fenced Goods
subtitle: Hidden until its prerequisite rule is met
description: The fence does not appear while there is any chance of an audience:
`hideUntilDependenciesComplete` keeps the quest off the canvas
until its prerequisite rule is satisfied -- the same rule the
card's 'met' counts, honouring `minRequired` and the started-based
modes rather than a flat all-done.
